title: 第19章 去买房售楼经理第20章 兰家有女名玥瑜
content_zh:
豪华的总统套房。
事后。
柳飘絮拉过被子盖上，身体转了过去，眼睛突然有些通红。
一个月消失不见，再听到他的消息，是自己被抓起来的时候，要不是以死相逼，身体都要被凌辱，现在他一个电话，自己就连夜跑出来开房，半个拒绝的字眼都没有。
不知道应该说自己贱，还是说自己傻。
“明天，咱们去买套房子，写你名字。”张扬说道。
“你哪来的钱？”
柳飘絮震惊地看着他。
“我没钱，但有人送。”
“你不会去干犯法的事情了吧？”
张扬笑了起来，法律只能限制普通老百姓，根本限制不了陈天龙兰天庭之辈，更别提自己这种修仙者了。
“我帮一个人办了件事情，他要送我套房子。”
张扬没跟她说自己继承了陈家的产业，不然不吓死她才怪。
“为什么要买房？”
“不买房，咱们上哪住，总不能天天去酒店开房吧？”
“在哪买？”
“明天你就知道了。”
无论柳飘絮怎么问，张扬就是不说，不然哪来的惊喜。
第二天，柳飘絮请了半天假，跟张扬去看房。
来到楼盘地址的时候，她吓了一跳，这可是江南最贵的商品房，价格去到三万多。

“请问先生，想看什么房？”
一名身材高挑的售楼小姐走了过来，客气地询问。
张扬看了她胸牌一眼，上面写着‘销售经理谷美玲’五个字。
“陈军给我留了房子，你知道吗？”张扬问。
这里是陈家的产业，名义上属于陈军，实则上张扬占最大股份。
“我问问，两位稍等。”
听到陈军二字，谷美玲眼睛瞬间亮了，急匆匆走了。
片刻之后，谷美玲过来，身边跟着一名戴眼镜的中年男子。
“苏先生你好，我叫潘树岩，是海玥滨江销售总经理，陈老板已经安排过，房子随便选，请问你需要看哪种户型？”潘树岩态度十分恭敬。
“问我女朋友。”
“柳女士，请问你有什么需求？”
柳飘絮有些懵，一时之间不知道应该怎么选。
正在这时候，电话响了起来，是陈军打来的。
张扬走到一边接通，陈军道：“扬哥，咱们昨晚砸了兰家五个场子，我还按你的要求，叫了一群鬼火少年，开着机车，拉着鞭炮，在兰家大院旁边放了一夜，还扔了十几炮加强版的进去，兰家的人一夜没睡，估计已经气死了。”
“干得好，今晚继续，记住，别正面冲突。”
“是，扬哥。”
挂掉电话，张扬走到沙发上坐下。
潘树岩跟柳飘絮站在沙盘边，介绍着楼盘情况，张扬不想影响柳飘絮判断，没有过去。
“张先生，喝杯水。”
谷美玲走过来，递过一杯水。

“谢谢。”
张扬伸手过去，不小心碰到她的手。
脑海中马上跳出一行字：非元阴体，阴气值400。
突破炼气二层之后，张扬探查阴气值的数值，也有了增强。
一年多没有男人碰过，阴气值积累了不少，模样也长得不错。
content_en:
Luxurious presidential suite.
afterwards.
Liu Piaoxu pulled the quilt over her and turned around, her eyes suddenly turned red.
After disappearing for a month, the next time I heard from him was when I was arrested. If I hadn't threatened him with death, my body would have been humiliated. Now when he called me, I ran out to check out a room at night without even a word of rejection.
I don’t know whether I should call myself cheap or stupid.
"Tomorrow, let's buy a house and write your name on it." Zhang Yang said.
"Where did you get the money?"
Liu Piaoxu looked at him in shock.
"I have no money, but someone will give it to me."
"You're not going to do anything illegal, are you?"
Zhang Yang laughed. The law can only restrict ordinary people, but it cannot restrict people like Chen Tianlong and Lan Tianting at all, let alone immortal cultivators like himself.
"I helped a man do something, and he wanted to give me a house."
Zhang Yang didn't tell her that he inherited the Chen family's property, otherwise it would be strange if he didn't scare her to death.
“Why buy a house?”
"If we don't buy a house, where will we live? We can't go to hotels every day to get rooms, right?"
"Where to buy?"
"You'll find out tomorrow."
No matter how Liu Piaoxu asked, Zhang Yang just didn't say anything, otherwise there would be no surprise.
The next day, Liu Piaoxu took half a day off to go see a house with Zhang Yang.
When she arrived at the property address, she was shocked. This was the most expensive commercial housing in Jiangnan, with a price of more than 30,000 yuan.
"Excuse me sir, what room do you want to see?"
A tall sales lady came over and asked politely.
Zhang Yang glanced at her badge, which read 'Sales Manager Gu Meiling'.
"Chen Jun left me a house, did you know?" Zhang Yang asked.
This is the property of the Chen family. It belongs to Chen Jun in name, but in fact Zhang Yang holds the largest share.
"Let me ask, please wait a moment."
When she heard the word Chen Jun, Gu Meiling's eyes instantly lit up and she hurried away.
After a while, Gu Meiling came over, followed by a middle-aged man wearing glasses.
"Hello, Mr. Su, my name is Pan Shuyan, and I am the sales general manager of Haiyue Binjiang. Boss Chen has already arranged it. You can choose any house at will. Which house type do you want to see?" Pan Shuyan's attitude was very respectful.
"Ask my girlfriend."
"Ms. Liu, what do you need?"
Liu Piaoxu was a little confused and didn't know what to choose for a moment.
At this moment, the phone rang, it was Chen Jun.
Zhang Yang went to the side to answer the call, and Chen Jun said: "Brother Yang, we destroyed five areas of the Lan family last night. According to your request, I called a group of will-o'-the-wisp teenagers to drive a motorcycle and pull firecrackers. They set them next to the Lan family compound all night. They also threw more than a dozen enhanced cannons in. The Lan family didn't sleep all night, and they are probably mad to death."
"Well done, let's continue tonight. Remember, don't confront us."
"Yes, Brother Yang."
After hanging up the phone, Zhang Yang walked to the sofa and sat down.
Pan Shuyan and Liu Piaoxu stood by the sand table and introduced the real estate situation. Zhang Yang did not want to influence Liu Piaoxu's judgment and did not go there.
"Mr. Zhang, drink a glass of water."
Gu Meiling came over and handed over a glass of water.
"Thank you."
Zhang Yang reached out and accidentally touched her hand.
A line of words immediately popped into my mind: Non-Yin body, Yin Qi value is 400.
After breaking through the second level of Qi Refining, Zhang Yang's ability to detect the Yin Qi value also increased.
She hasn't been touched by a man for more than a year, so she has accumulated a lot of yin energy and looks good.
